## 4.1.22 (HexGhoul): first person for the kagune-made weapons

HexKagune 4.1.22 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Previews: `docs/handoff/first-person-bone_sword-4.1.22.png`,
`first-person-flesh_hammer-4.1.22.png`, `first-person-crystal_spear-4.1.22.png` (third person on top, first person under it, at the same
moments of every blow).

Your words: "Just as soon as you finish the katana, just make the first person of the other weapons. Don't touch their looks."

**What it was:** the quinques with a stance (the blade, the spear, the katana, the mace, Dawn) were already drawn in first person exactly as
the body swings them (4.1.19). The kagune-made weapons (the bone greatsword, the flesh hammer, the crystal spear) still used a separate
first-person motion that didn't match their third person blows.

**Now:** those three are drawn in first person on your posed arm, exactly as their third person blows swing them, seen from behind your
head: same arm, same turn in the fist, same step in. Their looks are untouched.

**Kept as they were, on purpose:**
- **The launcher:** drawn through the body it floats side-on above the crosshair; its own view aims down the crosshair, as a gun should.
- **The whip:** its tendril is laid along a path of its own in first person; the handle alone through the body would part from it.
